headline: Nigeria's Access Holdings Reports 8.3% Rise in Pre-Tax Profit
summary: Access Holdings announced a nine-month profit before tax of approximately US$495 million, an 8.3% increase, while profit after tax rose 5.95% to US$352 million.
why: Access Holdings is one of Nigeria's largest financial services groups. Its earnings provide insight into the health of the Nigerian banking sector and broader economic conditions in the region.

impacts.name: Access Holdings
impacts.why: The company reported growth in both pre-tax and after-tax profits.
